CustomField.description: QualifiedApiName of a Form (Form__mdt, object Form_Template) that the formTemplate runtime renders as the form's footer band below the pages. Use this for a fully designed, themed footer instead of plain Footer Text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the API name of the Form component to render as this template's footer. Leave blank for no Form-driven footer.
CustomField.label: FormQualifiedApiName (Footer)
